# Relation format

> Generated by `tools/` from the inputs in `source/`. Every statement below is backed by assembly metadata, IL, or a supplied export sample.
> Anything that could not be proven from those inputs is marked **Unknown** rather than guessed.

**Source table:** `MET_RELATIONDEF` · **Confidence:** Verified

Barsa separates the relation *definition* (`MET_RELATIONDEF`) from relation *instances* (`met_Relation`, `$basicInfoRelation`). Both are present in the samples.

Instance rows carry `SourceId`, `DestId`, `Role`, `RelationDefId`.

| Column | XSD type | Nullable in schema | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Title` | string | yes | Forward display name. |
| `RelationType` | int | yes | Cardinality/kind discriminator — value set Unknown. |
| `Max` | int | yes | Upper bound on the relation. |
| `SourceTypeId` | long | yes | MET_TYPEDEF at the source end. |
| `DestTypeId` | long | yes | MET_TYPEDEF at the destination end. |
| `isBilateral` | boolean | yes | Whether the relation is navigable both ways. |
| `ReverseTitle` | string | yes | Reverse display name. |
| `destTypeExtraString` | string | yes |  |
| `sourceTypeExtraString` | string | yes |  |
| `ID` | long | yes | Primary key. |
| `SourceFieldDefId` | long | yes | Field that carries the relation, when any. |

Column meanings left blank are **Unknown**: the column name alone is not
evidence of its semantics.
